situation (example wording): "Robberies by weapon in Texas in 2024" (no chart), "the 10 cities with the most murders in 2024", "murders in Dallas and Houston by month"
what the app does today: Only a time series of one count got a chart; a breakdown by a category, a ranking and several places over time showed a table alone.
proposed behavior: A chart follows the shape of the answer: a series over months a line, over years bars; a one-period breakdown by one category a bar chart of the count, the categories in the table's order (largest first, the natural order for ages and hours, Unknown last); a ranking or a table of places a bar chart of the figure in rank order; several places over months one line per place. A single figure and a one-row table have no chart. The panel turns a bar chart sideways when the labels crowd. A count by two fields (stacked bars) and clearance by type (100% stacked) come when the two-breakdown shape is built (Jeff 2026-11-21). A request to change a chart by typing stays declined (P157); the change is made by the page's own controls once the redesign has them.
why: Jeff 2026-11-21 (through the coordinator): bars for one-period breakdowns and rankings, several lines for several places, stacked for two fields; users change the chart type through the redesign's buttons, not by typing.
